title: Glowing tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffff88' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffff88' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#88ddff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4488cc'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wheelGlow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffaa44'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc7722'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='48' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x='62' y='28' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#aaaacc'/>
  <rect x='61' y='26' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ccccee'/>
  <!-- Smoke puffs -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='22' r='4' fill='#ddeeff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='17' r='3' fill='#ddeeff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='15' r='2.5' fill='#ddeeff' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Cab body -->
  <rect x='38' y='34' width='30' height='26' rx='4' fill='url(#bodyGlow)'/>
  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x='42' y='38' width='13' height='11' rx='2' fill='#aaffee'/>
  <rect x='43' y='39' width='5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Engine hood -->
  <rect x='10' y='44' width='32' height='18' rx='4' fill='#66bbee'/>
  <rect x='10' y='44' width='32' height='6' rx='3' fill='#99ddff'/>
  <!-- Grill lines -->
  <rect x='12' y='50' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4488bb'/>
  <rect x='12' y='54' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4488bb'/>
  <rect x='12' y='58' width='28' height='2' rx='1' fill='#4488bb'/>
  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='47' r='4' fill='#ffff66'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='47' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Headlight beam -->
  <polygon points='10,47 0,40 0,54' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.3'/>
  <!-- Fender over big wheel -->
  <path d='M40,68 Q40,54 58,54 Q76,54 76,68 Z' fill='#5599dd'/>
  <!-- Big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='14' fill='url(#wheelGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='10' fill='#ffcc66'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='4' fill='#886633'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='2' fill='#665522'/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1='58' y1='58' x2='58' y2='64' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='72' x2='58' y2='78' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='48' y1='68' x2='54' y2='68' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='68' x2='68' y2='68' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Small front wheel -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='9' fill='url(#wheelGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='6' fill='#ffcc66'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#886633'/>
  <!-- Small wheel spokes -->
  <line x1='22' y1='66' x2='22' y2='69' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='75' x2='22' y2='78' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='16' y1='72' x2='19' y2='72' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='25' y1='72' x2='28' y2='72' stroke='#886633' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Axle -->
  <rect x='28' y='66' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7799bb'/>
  <!-- Little happy face on cab -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#335588'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#335588'/>
  <path d='M46,49 Q50,53 54,49' stroke='#335588' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#aaffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='45' r='1.5' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
